description: Member of a small team building a social media marketing application, working across both internal tooling
for the operations and growth teams and external facing web applications used directly by users, making
heavy use of Claude Code throughout the codebase. Built and enhanced interactive Hex dashboards using SQL,
dynamic parameters and Markdown integrated with GCP BigQuery, empowering non-technical stakeholders across
the business to self-serve operational metrics.
Lead developer for a flagship application feature, partnering with the Director of Growth and Design to
scope requirements, architected an extensive PostgreSQL schema, managed sprint tickets and assignments, and
authored the core backend logic—delivering the feature ahead of schedule with no post-launch issues.
